title: shinylaunchR: Cross-platform desktop launchpad for R and Shiny applications
description: shinylaunchR is a desktop launcher that presents R and Shiny applications as a grid of tiles and opens each one in its own native window while R runs in the background. Applications are grouped into three families: those shipped as R packages, those consisting of loose Shiny source files supplied as an archive, folder, gist or source repository, and those already hosted at a web address. Package tiles use the package's own logo where one exists, and locally supplied applications are staged into a private directory before being run. It is aimed at researchers and teams who want to distribute Shiny tools to colleagues who do not work from an R console.
